blind.description: A stylized low wooden apothecary shelving unit featuring a small two-door cupboard at the base, two open shelves, and an open top surface. It is densely stocked with alchemical supplies including green and amber potion bottles with cork stoppers, glazed white ceramic jars with lids, piles of dried green herbs, a stone mortar and pestle, and a green demijohn seated in a woven basket casing. The back is clad in vertical wooden boards.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with square corner post caps, displaying a row of items along its top: a round lidded white jar, a green bottle in a round wicker basket, an irregular bushy clump of dried green herbs, and a round reddish-brown bottle.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 3 feet wide.
